test_title: PYST 28: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 4 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All T are P.

All C are P.

Some O are C.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some T are C.

II. Some P are T.

III. Some P are O.

options.text: Both conclusions II and III follow
Either conclusion I or II follows

solution:
**Statements:**

All T are P.

All C are P.

Some O are C.

**Possible Venn diagram:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30e26c4fdecefd798f5f765869667b254c98862eafdb488218b86d4ab0332b7c.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some T are C → False (It is not correct because there is no definite relation between them)

II. Some P are T →** True** (Since all T are P)

III. Some P are O →** True** (Since all C are P and some O are C)

**Both conclusions II and III follow.**

Hence,** 'option 2'** is the correct answer.
